newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Tellus reports loss for 2nd yr.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Tellus reports loss for 2nd yr.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share -0.75 yuan vs 0.0015 yuan Net assets per share 1.36 yuan vs 2.11 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Tellus Holdings Co Ltd.

Note: The results, compiled under Chinese accounting standards except for net profits which were based on international standards, were published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Wednesday.
Based on Chinese accounting standards, the company posted net losses of 165.70 million yuan in 1996 against a net profit of 330,000 yuan in 1995.
The company's board of directors proposed no dividend for 1996, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting which has yet to be scheduled.
Trading in Tellus' A and B shares was suspended on Wednesday morning and will resume in the afternoon, according to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange.
